title: Strict henselization is faithfully flat
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring with residue field $k$, let $K$ be a separable closure of $k$, and let $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be the strict henselization obtained as the filtered colimit of etale $R$-algebras equipped with a point over the closed point and a residue-field embedding into $K$ [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. Then the canonical local ring map $R\to R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (1): R -> R^h -> R^sh are faithfully flat; R^sh as constructed in Algebra, Lemma Tag 04GP (lemma-strict-henselization)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples] to obtain filteredness and a local colimit c0 with structure map rho0 and residue map psi0. Its maximal ideal is ker psi0, whose contraction is p. Using hp, the local_hom_TFAE criterion makes rho0 local. The unique colimit isomorphism e : c.pt -> c0.pt satisfies rho ; e = rho0: evaluate the two compatibility equations on the identity triple and use the colimit factorization equation. Transport the local-ring structure along e and reflect units through e to make rho local.

Use the fully faithful functor from triples to arrows B -> K out of affine etale R-algebras, as in the existing EtaleResidueTriplesExistsColimit proof. The affine etale category is essentially small by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-essentially-small-cover]; Mathlib essential smallness for costructured arrows and fully faithful functors gives a small model of the triples. Transfer filteredness across the small-model equivalence and whisker the supplied colimit along its inverse. The structural maps of the triples give a natural transformation from the constant R diagram; naturality is the equation Under.w on a morphism of triples.

Every structural map in the small diagram is etale by the defining field of its triple. Translate scheme etaleness with HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff; etale algebras are flat by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-flat]. Apply RingHom.Flat.of_isColimit, the colimit-presentation form of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-iff-ind-flat], to the whiskered colimit and the structural natural transformation. Its common-composite condition is precisely hρ. This proves flatness of rho without constructing an additional module diagram.

Install the algebra structure induced by rho. The preceding flatness and localness results satisfy Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom, the first clause of [lem-pc-local-flat-faithful-flat-reflects-surjective]. Its conclusion is definitionally rho.hom.FaithfullyFlat.
